STRICT TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE ELEVATION, facing RIGHT: camera perpendicular to the long side, at axle/fuselage/hull level, zero yaw, zero pitch. Show ONLY the side, never front/rear faces or top surfaces. Wheels perfectly circular, far-side wheels occluded, wheel hubs aligned on one horizontal baseline. No perspective, no three-quarter view, no foreshortening, no cast ground shadows, no environment, no text, no labels. Genuine transparent background. Composition: three equally sized colour variants LEFT TO RIGHT in three clearly separated equal-width columns, with generous clear transparent gutters and margins. All three are identical geometry and pose, only paint changes (ivory, sage green, muted terracotta). Subject: a modern container cargo ship sailing RIGHT, bow RIGHT, stern bridge superstructure LEFT, long broadside hull with level waterline. Top row stacked rectilinear shipping containers on deck, their side faces only; bottom row same ship with empty cargo deck. No water. TWO rows, SIX sprites total. Top row LOADED, bottom row EMPTY. Bottom-row body and wheels exactly match and align with the corresponding top-row sprite when rows are overlaid, identical size, shape and paint. Use a roomy 3:2 LANDSCAPE canvas with at least 10% of canvas height completely transparent between the two rows and wide empty column gutters. Reference shows the required style and strict side projection. Even for ships and aircraft show side elevation only, no diagonal deck or wing perspective.

prompts.subject: a futuristic huge space-age ocean cargo ship sailing RIGHT, streamlined pointed bow RIGHT, tall rounded advanced bridge at stern LEFT, long broadside ivory hull with blue accents and level waterline. Top row neatly stacked cargo modules on deck; bottom row same empty cargo deck. No water
